title: One local-C2 Laplacian product rule for Poisson kernels and compact smooth graphs
source_anchor: Printed page13/PDF page21, Eq1.19; used for Prop1.18 and Prop1.20(b), then paper2610.20492v1 AppendixA1
target_statement: Canonical local form of Eq1.19: for a finite-dimensional real inner product space \(E\), including dimensions zero and one, a point \(x\in E\), and real functions \(f,g\) which are C² locally at \(x\), the actual Laplacian and Riesz gradients satisfy \(\Delta(fg)(x)=f(x)\Delta g(x)+2\langle\nabla f(x),\nabla g(x)\rangle+g(x)\Delta f(x)\). The book states the real product rule for C² functions on their open domain in its standing dimension \(n>1\); the displayed canonical form localizes at one point and makes the low-dimensional extension explicit. It asserts no harmonicity or integral value.
